_comment: The deep dive's sandbox fight (combat rework S9; its test plan, items 1 to 3): three bots, each with the five-verb kit Basic (strike), Shred, Heavy Shot (heavy_strike), Brace and Wait (always there), against one Charger, one Plated and one Scaler. No meta layer, no leveling. The simulation harness plays it by default (tools/batch_sim.gd --policies, data/scenarios/_harness.json); the scenario builder loads it and plays it on the battle screen (Play on battle screen), and the dev menu opens it directly (Sandbox fight).
_seed_comment: The enemies are listed, so the seed would only pick enemies and every seed would be the same fight (questions row 67). opening_gauge_spread_percent gives each of the six units a seeded head start of 0 to that percent of a turn, so the seed changes who acts first and when the Charger's Ram lands, while the units, stats and kits stay the deep dive's test fight.
